newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 6.

text.p: Leading securities houses estimate that about 150 companies will list their shares on the over-the-counter (OTC) market in calendar 1997, including the new second sector of the OTC market which started operations in December.
Canon Inc plans to withdraw from the personal computer (PC) business and transfer all PC operations to its sales unit. Canon wants to focus its resources in digital cameras and printers.
